title: job.transitioned
description: The job moved from one node to another. A justified divergence from flowpilot's EventKind.STATE_CHANGE: nodes of the graph frozen per version, not the 12 fixed states of a TicketState.

from_node_id.description: The origin node; null on the first transition, when the job leaves the entry node for the first time.

to_node_id.description: The destination node, within the graph version frozen for this execution.
